name: Purple
source:
"Purple" is originally based on Amanda Todd's video where she is seen flipping through written cards describing her story. Unfortunately, she is no longer with us due to the depression she experienced from bullying.

If there is anyone who is experiencing any bullying or feels like there is no other option in life know that there is help.

[Edited from [url=http://ryusenka.deviantart.com/art/Purple-335450809]DeviantArt[/url]]
